system.description:
Perceived Weakness – Momentary Flaw.

Momentary Flaw is treated as an Elemental Condition. Creatures with it have a weakness that only the Scout that identified it can exploit. They suffer the following effects.

Increase the damage they take from the inflicting Scout-Nin by +2. This increases to +4 at 10th and +6 at 17th level.

Increase the chakra cost to cast jutsu with a casting time of 1 Reaction, by +6. This increases to +12 at 10th and +18 at 17th level.

Jutsu you cast with the Barrier keyword that summons a structure or construct that intercepts damage, reduces the amount of hit points it has or damage it intercepts, by half.
system.summary: Takes +2 damage from the Scout (+4 at 10th, +6 at 17th); reaction jutsu cost +6 (+12, +18); its damage-intercepting Barriers are halved.

rules.text: Only the Scout who inflicted it adds the extra damage (by the Scout's level). Its 1-Reaction jutsu cost more, and its Barrier constructs that intercept damage have half the hit points or interception.
